sources.snippet: Overview Ouro-1.4B-Thinking is a reasoning-specialized language model created by ByteDance that contains 1.4 billion parameters across 24 layers and achieves performance competitive with 4B-parameter models despite its smaller size. sources.title: ouro-ai-labs/ouro: Ouro is an open-source AI agent - GitHub
sources.snippet: An open-source AI agent — run it as a Coding agent CLI or deploy it as a bot just like JARVIS. Ouro is derived from Ouroboros—the ancient symbol of a serpent consuming its own tail to form a perfect circle. It represents the ultimate cycle: a closed loop of self-consumption, constant renewal, and infinite iteration.
